Irene (PM): Heads-up  need a quick RICE recalibration for next quarter. Two enterprise pilots are pushing impact high; want to decompose and add a sequence penalty. Carlos?
Carlos (Eng): Yes. Breaking epics into smaller slices will let us ship earlier. Example: 'kms-integration' -> adapter (1w), audit-export (2w), rotation plan (3w). Also note DB migration windows = +hidden effort.
Lina (Data): Did a quick rank-sensitivity: if impact weights shift to favor breadth (0.6 reach,0.25 revenue,0.15 ops), predictive-cache jumps from rank 14 to 5. I'll post the small CSV.
Ben (Sales): Sales prefers incremental slices too. A 1-week adapter unlocks 3 pilots.
Irene (PM): Proposed actions: 1) split large epics; 2) add sequence_cost = dependents * 0.4 (penalty); 3) rerun RICE and produce top-20 delta. Can team deliver numbers by EOD?
Carlos (Eng): I can reestimate top 12 efforts today.
Lina (Data): I'll output normalized scores + rank deltas by 4pm.
Ben (Sales): I'll mark which slices unblock >1 deal.
Irene (PM): Reconvene 16:30 to triage. Thanks. :thumbsup:
